audience: IELTS learners preparing through official practice and short courses
brief: Show the actual learning content and progression, using only attributed factual statements.

facts.text: IELTS Ready includes practice activities and mock tests.
The free package lists short courses in Speaking and Listening.
The package includes live expert webinars.

assetSources.capture: Original course-content overview of the three confirmed facts; no copied interface, logo or image.
Course overview and curriculum only; exclude portraits, testimonials, personal accounts and third-party embedded videos.

notes: Do not imply guaranteed band improvement or present the Premium package as unconditionally included. Do not reuse learner testimonials, scores or portraits.

confirmation.allowedUse: Official-source product features and course contents only; no invented outcomes; no public renders.

materialLicenseReview.basis: The official terms permit personal, non-commercial use with credit but restrict other purposes, modifications and graphics separated from their accompanying text. A project-owner approval alone does not establish this third-party permission.
materialLicenseReview.requiredEvidence: Permission covering internal product-development video evaluation and the intended screenshot use, or another source with a compatible documented license.

alternatives.description: Public official Premium user manual with interface examples; not ingested, do not treat Premium as the free package.
Public British Council Canada product page; not ingested.

originalMaterialApproval.decision: Use an original factual course-content diagram instead of an authorized screenshot. Show only confirmed practice, short-course and live expert webinar facts; do not imitate the course interface.
